notes.title: New Gun Shop 2025: Black Case Armory
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era! The long-awaited new gun shop of 2025 is finally here: [b]Black Case Armory[/b]! You can look for it on your map or just head straight to where the old Snow Resort building was to find it. The shop features higher tier G$ guns at prices within BAR and XCRO's price range, and a little beyond depending on what you're getting. The intent of the release is to close the gap some between limited users and the average player, so set some goals![/p][p][/p][p]The shop features [b]12[/b] new weapons, the return of [b]SV-DKR[/b], and [b]5[/b] new skins for it. All weapons will remain permanently available, and there are no limiteds for this release. Prices range from [b]150000[/b] - [b]500000[/b], and all weapons can be rented. We suggest renting before you buy so that you can get a proper feel for a release before spending your hard earned money permanently![/p][p][/p][p][b]As a reminder, all new weapons are still subject to balancing changes, and the weapons have changed significantly since they were last teased, so we suggest reading the physical information stands within the shop for in-depth weapon information before purchase, and joining [/b][url="htttps://www.discord.gg/Graalians" style="button"]our Discord[/url] [b]to stay up to date with any new balancing patches over at #era-patch-notes.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Double jobs will be enabled for the rest of the week soon to commemorate the release. Cheers and thanks for playing Era![/p]

notes.title: September 2025 VIP
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era! September's VIP item is finally out: [b]The Edgecrank Hammer[/b]! It's an 8 damage melee which comes with a "Super Shot" ability. The effect applied to victims on hit depends on the skin you currently have equipped for it:[/p][p][/p][p][b]Default[/b]: Knock Back on Projectile Hit[/p][p][b]Purple[/b]: Poison on Projectile Hit[/p][p][b]Blue[/b]: Confusion on Projectile Hit[/p][p][b]Pink[/b]: Burn on Projectile Hit[/p][p][/p][p]You can purchase the skins now over at the old VIP Shop building above Start![/p][p][/p][p]We've also thrown in the usual [b]1500 VIP Cookies[/b] and [b]5000 Upload Tokens[/b] for monthly subscribers. Thanks for playing Era![/p]

notes.title: Block 14 Car Shop
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Era! A massive new car shop has released over at the location of the old car dealer: [b]Block 14 Car Shop[/b]! It currently offers 50 new cars! The shop's inventory is divided into three sections:[/p][p]
[b]Main Floor[/b][/p][p][b]Lower Garage Floor[/b][/p][p][b]Premium Garage[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Fifteen higher price point cars are locked behind the secretive Premium Garage and entry to it is something we'll leave to you to figure out! Come check it out and as always: Thanks for playing Era![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: August 2025 VIP Release
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era! August's monthly VIP item is now out: [b]The Banana Cannon[/b]! Three unique skins for it have also been released over at the [b]VIP Shop[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]This month's VIP item is an explosive launcher with a secondary grenade mode which fires banana grenades similar in functionality to the Pumpkin Bomb. (These banana grenades are additionally disabled within safe zones and bases to prevent abuse.)[/p][p][/p][p]VIP subscribers for August have also been granted their usual 5000 [b]Upload Tokens[/b] and 1500 [b]VIP Cookies[/b]. Log on now to claim your monthly rewards and thanks for playing Era![/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Camping Shop 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era. A small new shop has opened up over at the old [b]Camping Shop[/b] map which features some new camping-themed hats furniture and items![/p][p][/p][p]The new shop will remain permanently open and was part of our back-logged releases from the past couple years which we've been making steady progress to push out. [b]It can be found to the top left of the camping map which you can search "Camping" on your player map to locate![/b][/p][p][/p][p]And as always: Thanks for playing Era![/p]

notes.title: Exotic Laboratories 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era! After a long wait we're excited to finally announce the opening of the long-awaited new exotic shop! For those in possession of the [b]Mysterious Crystal[/b] currency you can now access the exotic shop within the deepest parts of the laboratory to redeem it for either the [b]Stronghold Nexus[/b] or [b]Matter Matrix[/b] gun.[/p][p][/p][p]Additionally for everybody else: We've scattered a few free hats around the facility as well as introduced two new furniture shops for those who manage to beat the mini-quest to gain access to the exotic laboratory itself. An achievement is also obtainable if you manage to restore power back to the downed lift! Owners of the Mysterious Crystal currency can choose to skip this mini-quest altogether and head straight to the shop.[/p][p][/p][p]This release marks the beginning of a steady roll-out of long overdue mysterious currency items. While it's been four years in the making we are actively working through our backlog to help bring those items into owner hands faster.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and for playing Era. [b]You can access the new laboratory levels by heading over to the old mansion island located at the bottom right of the map above Aim Point Island.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers![/p]

notes.title: Haunted Harbors 2025
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era! Haunted Harbors 2025 is now live! The ghosts of slain pirates have began to spawn all across the shores of Era! Players can either dig or fish for a chance to spawn a ghost pirate. Each ghost pirate you slay has a varying chance to drop random loot. Collected pirate loot can be taken to a sunken pirate ship and exchanged for either [b]Gralats[/b] or [b]Pirate Coins[/b] or even [b]Event Coins[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Loot exchanged for [b]Pirate Coins[/b] can be spent at the sunken ship's shop for unique hats or items. This year we've prepared nearly 50 new hats and a dozen new items.[/p][p][/p][p]As per our recent [url="https://discord.gg/Graalians"]Discord[/url] community poll: All trade-disabled items from this year and the previous year will make annual returns and both pirate coins and pirate loot will no longer be reset year-by-year. This essentially turns the shop into a permanent shop and players do not have to worry about beloved items going away if they cannot grind in time for them this year.[/p][p][/p][p]You can find the entrance to the sunken ship by grabbing the NPC outside of the Shell Shop or at Start Park! Happy grinding and thanks for playing Era![/p]

notes.title: 4th of July and Canada Day Shop 2025
notes.notes: [p]Happy belated Canada Day and happy 4th of July from Era's team! Two small shops for 4th of July and Canada Day have now released over at the [b]Holiday Shop Island[/b]! Find it on your map![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally a statement regarding the future of both holidays and similar smaller holiday content like it has been posted over at [b]#era-announcements[/b] within our official community [url="https://discord.gg/Graalians"]Discord[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Both shops will be going away on [b]July 20th[/b]! Thanks for playing Era.[/p]

notes.title: July 2025 VIP
notes.notes: [p]Hey Era! July's VIP item is here now: [b]The Deadwake Cutlass! [/b]It's an 8 damage sword with a chance to inflict a black burn with every attack. It can also activate a 5 HP heal special with a cool show-off animation before going on cool down. There are three available skins for it over at the VIP Shop you can go purchase now![/p][p][/p][p]Additionally all VIP subscribers have also received their monthly [b]5000 Upload Tokens[/b] and [b]1500 VIP Cookies[/b]. Login to claim your rewards or purchase VIP from the in-game phone menu to receive this month's rewards and thanks for playing Era![/p]

notes.title: June 2025 VIP Release
notes.notes:
Hey Era players: This month's VIP item is finally out: [b]The Bubblenator-X[/b]! A novelty 8 damage water blaster with a clip of 10 and a moderate knock back chance. Additionally: Five purchasable VIP skins are now available for it over at the VIP Shop next to the auction house! Use your map to find it!

We've also thrown in the standard 5000 Upload Tokens and 1500 VIP Cookies for subscribers release. And as usual: Thanks for playing Era!

notes.title: Butterfly Hunting Event 2025
notes.notes:
Hey Era! We've chosen to bring back an old favorite this Spring: The [b]Butterfly Hunting Event[/b] is live once again! That means butterflies and bugs have began spawning all across Era from now until July 4th at 12 PM EST. You can catch and collect bugs with new nets sold at the Holiday Shop Island! Additionally there are 20 new achievements to obtain this year for different bug collecting milestones!

Bugs can be exchanged with the Bug Collector for Butterfly Coins at a rate of 1 bug per 1 coin. Rare bugs like the Rainbow Beetle or Golden Butterfly are worth 10 coins each. [b]Alternatively this year we've also introduced a means for players to earn money for grinding the event which means you'll now be able to exchange your Butterfly Coins for Gralats at a rate of 1 coin per 10 Gralats![/b]

We've prepared a large collection of new furniture alongside new hats and items this year. A video will be posted on the official GraalOnline YouTube channel soon showcasing this year's items. Make sure to follow our socials or join our official over at [url=discord.gg/Graalians]discord.gg/Graalians[/url] for further updates or announcements regarding the event.

Get out there and catch some bugs!

notes.title: Cinco de Mayo 2025
notes.notes:
The Cinco de Mayo shop at the very top of Era City has opened once again! You can use your in-game map to locate it.

This year we've taken a different spin on the holiday: Instead of the usual G$ shop we've put together a new map-wide event where pinatas are now spawning across all of Era and it's up to you to find and break them in return for lots of delicious candy!

You will find the Pinata Stick item sold for 100 G$ within the Cinco de Mayo shop. Purchase and equip it to use it on pinatas found across the map. Each hit on a pinata has a chance to yield brand new food and an even tinier chance to drop the ultra rare [b]Legendary Chili Revolver[/b].

When a pinata bursts each player within the vicinity who helped destroy it will receive varying payouts of our new [b]Mexican Candy[/b] currency. Mexican Candy or MC currency for short can be exchanged for festive new loot at this year's shop or alternatively exchanged for G$ at a rate of 1 MC per 10 Gralats.

The event will run from now until May 25th after which the shop will close and pinatas will quit spawning around the map. So head out there and take advantage of the festivities to earn lots!

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/Graalians]Official Discord Community[/url] for more in-depth event patch notes and announcements.

notes.title: May 2025 VIP
notes.notes:
Hey Era! May's VIP item is finally here: The Tortilla Katana! This month's item is a fast 9 damage melee with a burn status effect and 4 bullet gun mode (Budget AM Katana?). 1500 VIP cookies and 5000 upload tokens have also been included as a bonus for all subscribers.

You can visit the VIP Shop above Start Park to purchase 6 additional skins for it. Thanks for playing GraalOnline Era! 🪇

notes.title: Easter Shop 2025
notes.notes:
Easter bunnies and plastic eggs have began spawning all around Era City! Head on down to the newly opened Easter shop over at Holiday Island to check out all we have in store this year! There are more than 12 items and dozens of hats and furniture to exchange your eggs for this year!

To start collecting eggs you can purchase an egg basket outside of the shop which you can then equip and attack with to pick up eggs found on the floor. There are dozens of Easter bunnies running around the map at any given time dropping eggs in their path which you can pick up with your basket. Alongside bunnies you can also find larger plastic eggs hidden all across the map which may contain anything from an Event Coin to Easter food to more eggs you can spend at this year's shop!

The shop will remain open until May 10th. Best of luck and thanks for playing GraalOnline Era!

[b]For more in-depth announcements and patches regarding this event or other releases you can stay up to date by joining our official [url=discord.gg/Graalians]Discord[/url]![/b]

notes.title: Era Egg Hunt 2025
notes.notes:
This year's egg hunt is now live! There are a total of thirteen eggs to find across Era City and fourteen total achievements to earn!

We won't spoil their locations but some are tied to everyday game-play and some might not offer themselves up to you unless you can beat their challenges! (And some might just outright refuse to be found in the first place.)

You can talk to the Easter Rabbit at Start Park to begin the challenge. Return to him with all eggs in tow once you've collected them for a reward. Good luck this year!

notes.title: GANI Shop Update 2025
notes.notes: Our animations team has prepared a large update for the old GANI Shop featuring dozens of new taunts and profile animations! All taunts can also now be used as profile animations when tapping your profile character under 'Taunts'! You can find the shop to the right of Box Factory Zone! Come check it out and thanks for playing GraalOnline Era!

notes.title: February 2025 Kill Challenge: Metal Storm
notes.notes:
Our monthly kill challenge has arrived: [b]The Dark Knight Metal Storm[/b]! You'll have until the 20th of March to obtain it!

Obtain [b]1500[/b] kills with the Metal Storm for a unique animated gas mask and [b]3000[/b] for an animated Metal Storm skin!

The Metal Storm gun can be found to the left of Start at Chris Z's Guns and can be either purchased or temporarily rented to partake in this month's kill challenge.

Say "showchallengekills" in overhead chat to check your total progress as you grind. For a preview of the gas mask and skin check out the NPC above the Trade House at Start Park.

Good luck and thanks for playing Era!

notes.title: Cupid Hunting Event 2025
notes.notes:
Love is in the air and it's that time of the year again! Cupid and his minions have taken to the streets of Era once more!

You can now wander around the map on your own or with allies to hunt down giant Cupid mobs as they spawn in random locations around the map. Join in on attacking them until they succumb and you'll earn a handful of Cupid hearts for each successfully taken down Cupid mob. These hearts can then be spent at the all-new Valentine's Day shop over at Holiday Island.

Until February 25th at 3:00 PM EST you'll also be able to grind for the 4500 hearts [b]Amorizer-3000[/b] gun which comes with a rage bullet special that heals you 1.5 on each hit! Head on down to the Holiday Island for more information and make sure to check out our Discord server at [b]discord.gg/Graalians[/b] for more in-depth information regarding our events including the new Affection's Edge side quest for February.

Want a video showcase?
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VohmnTVMosI]Item Showcase Video[/url]

notes.title: February VIP 2025
notes.notes: February's VIP item is finally here! The Heart Shield! While equipped all incoming damage is reduced by 30%. It also comes with a small healing special which heals your gang mates for 8 HP a shot! Make sure to also check out the VIP shop for some Heart Shield skins and thanks for playing GraalOnline Era!

notes.title: Chemical Event Shop 2024

notes.title: Ornament Town 2024
notes.notes:
Ornament Town has once again opened its gates to visitors! You can head to Ornament Town by grabbing the giant gingerbread house underneath Start Park, to the right of the recycling center.

For this year, we've prepared several new free hats and have hid them all over town. We've also updated Snow Resort with a new assortment of hats, as well as snow mittens, which you'll be able to use for five new snowman building hats you can only earn exclusively in Ornament Town this year!

Buildings like the Christmas shop and Lost Stockings shop have locked their doors for the time being and will re-open in the near future with all new goodies. Shops from last year and their content are also permanent and their locations can be found plotted on a new in-game map when entering Ornament Town.

Make sure to be on the lookout these next few weeks for an old and beloved job which will be making a return in Ornament Town as well! We'll be making a separate announcement in our official [url=https://discord.gg/Graalians]Discord[/url] and on Steam once the job makes a return.

notes.title: Snowman Building 2024
notes.notes:
Snow has blanketed Era City once again and snowman building is back for the season! Dress for the cold and grab some mittens at Start Park to make snowballs with! You can use your mittens on any patch of snow to accumulate snowballs and roll them into proper size to build snowmen. Slay the snowmen baddies that spawn and accumulate limited time hats as you go. We've got 10 new hats to find this year and a special gas mask.

Ornament Town will also be releasing within the next couple days and will include additional hats which you can earn for building snowmen exclusively at Ornament Town this year. Best of luck and happy holidays from Era!

notes.title: Christmas Presents 2024
notes.notes:
Presents have arrived on Era once again!

You can now gift or exchange up to 25 presents at a time with other players (Increased from last year's limit of 10). Present opening times this year have been staggered between 6 AM EST and 12 PM EST for different players. Your individual opening time will be assigned upon receiving your first present from another player. Opening times are spread out yearly to protect the server from lag caused by thousands of presents being opened at once.

For limited items obtainable through presents there is no first come first serve basis. Each individual present contains a unique ID. On Christmas before the first presents have been been opened the server will roll different rewards (Limited items included) at random for each present ID. This means the first few players to receive gifts from others when presents released have just as much of a chance at a limited as the very last players to receive gifts right before presents are able to be opened.

And as a reminder - There is no limit to how many presents you can give or receive! Happy holidays from GraalOnline Era!

notes.title: Pumpkin Harvest 2024
notes.notes:

Pumpkins of varying sizes can be seen spawning all across Era's map. Grab and carry these pumpkins over to any of the pumpkin houses to exchange them for pumpkin points! Varying pumpkin sizes will yield different exchange rates. You'll be able to exchange your points for a variety of different hats and items this year.

This year will feature the 50-stock limited [b]Rune Altar Staff[/b] and the following 8 achievements:

Happy harvesting!

notes.title: DSD-50 Kill Challenge
notes.notes:
Kill challenges on Era are back! This one centers on the DSD-50 sniper which can be purchased for 115000 G$ at Alphex Firearms on your map!

Participants will have one month to earn a total of 3000 kills with the DSD-50 sniper to obtain both gas mask and skin.

[b]1500 Kills with DSD-50:[/b] New Gas Mask

[b]3000 Kills with DSD-50:[/b] Limited Time DSD-50 Skin

You can type "showchallengekills" in your overhead chat at any time to view your current kills progress with the sniper. Good luck and let us know any suggestions you may have for future guns to be featured in kill challenges!

notes.title: October 2024 Game Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features or Changes[/h1]
[h3]Co-Leader Rank[/h3]
[list]
[*]A new co-leader rank has been introduced to gangs. A gang can only have one co-leader at a time.
[*]Users in the co-leader rank can manage the tag the same way the leader can without being able to disband, rename, or transfer the gang.
[*]Players are limited to co-leading a maximum of three gangs at a time.
[/list]
[h3]Favorites System[/h3]
[list]
[*]On top of hats, you can now also favorite heads, bodies, and shields which should display within their own favorites page.
[*]VIP members can enjoy an increased capacity of 4 favorite pages per category.
[*]To favorite an asset you must now long-press instead of double tapping. This is to prevent a slight delay in equipping.
[/list]
[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[h3]Shop Buying and Selling[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now purchase 10000 consumables at a time instead of 100. This goes for food, shovels, healing darts, and so forth.
[*]You can now sell custom amounts of any sellable such as shells or minerals.
[/list]
[h3]Fishing[/h3]
[list]
[*]The time to catch a fish before it escapes has been significantly increased. This should give players ample time to respond to bites.
[/list]
[h1]Steam Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Steam Deck[/h3]
[list]
[*]Steam Deck's in-game zoom has been increased to give users more visibility.
[/list]
[h1]General Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Digging Locations[/h3]
[list]
[*]Players can now dig with the new system at South Ridge's Beach Bar location.
[/list]
[h3]House Voting[/h3]
[list]
[*]A bug which prevented previous competition winners from re-entering contests has been fixed.
[*]Winning the competition should now correctly prevent you from re-entering for a total of one year only.
[/list]
[h3]Hat Favorites[/h3]
[list]
[*]A bug which prevented players with a large amount of hats from being able to favorite hats has been fixed.
[/list]
[h1]Item Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Spartan-32[/h3]
[list]
[*]The clip's last three bullets have had their freeze chance set to 25%. This is due to the 100% freeze chance being an unintentional oversight which lead to abuse.
[/list]
[h3]Mode Saving[/h3]
[list]
[*]Snowflake Staff will now save the last melee/gun state the player was in on re-equip.
[*]Anti-Matter Sword and Shield will now save the last melee/shield state the player was in on re-equip.
[*]Bat Wing Crossbow will now save the gun/wings state the player was in on re-equip.
[*]Chemical Gun will now save the slime/gun state the player was in on re-equip.
[*]Neutron Claws will now hold onto the enraged state on re-equip.
[/list]
[h3]Star Rifle[/h3]
[list]
[*]A bug with the Star Rifle's dash which caused it to not fire the bullet on dash and retain it in the clip has been fixed.
[/list]
[h3]Balancing and General Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Grave Digger's body block functionality should no longer body block the owner.
[*]The distance a Grave Digger's tomb must be to another spawned tomb has been increased and total tomb HP has been decreased. More in-depth changes for the item are over at our Discord.
[*]The Corrupt Trident's dashes have been increased from 1 to 2 and slightly shortened.
[*]The Manatee Mount from the Haunted Harbors event now gives a speed boost while on mount mode within the map.
[*]The Apocalypse Axe Gun has had a clip increase from 14 to 18. All freeze rates for reloading, mode switch, and firing have also been decreased.
[*]All Halloween Shop 2024 mounts can now move over water.
[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Shop 2024
notes.notes: The veil has thinned and multiple spirits have taken refuge over at the old Holiday Building! Halloween Shop 2024 is here! We've released a massive collection of new Halloween-themed hats, items, and furniture. The shop also features a player-submitted GFX hat room and will soon be updated to house some player-submitted items. The shop will remain open until November 30th, so look for the Holiday Shop on your map and get geared up for the spooky season!

notes.title: Haunted Harbors 2024
notes.notes:
The vengeful spirits of undead sailors have stormed the coasts of Era City! Purchase a fishing rod and head to the beaches to fish. As you fish, you'll run the chance of spawning a vengeful pirate ghost! Defeat these undead foes and collect the loot they drop, which will be exchangeable for a variety of goods this year, including Gralats, Event Coins, and pirate gold.

To exchange your earned loot, head on down to Pirate Zone and swim towards the ghost ship of Captain Kane found to the left. Dive down when you reach the undead captain, and you'll find yourself in a dark underwater cave! Swim to safety and you'll be greeted by the ghost crew of a sunken pirate vessel. Within this ship you'll be able to exchange your loot for currency. Gold coins can be traded in at two shops this year for a range of hats, items, and furniture.

All melees this year will be untradeable and are subject to stat changes based off player feedback. [b]If you do not have the fishing license to partake, we will be looking into enabling ghost pirates for digging to everyone while the event runs![/b] Join our official [url=discord.gg/Graalians]Discord[/url] for more information on updates and changes to the event!

notes.title: Crypt 2024
notes.notes:
Crypt 2024 is here! For more in-depth event information about gang rewards and rules for this year's competing gangs, view the announcement over at our [url=discord.gg/Graalians]Discord[/url]!
[h3]About[/h3]
Crypt is a gang-based event, where anybody can form a gang and team up to take down hordes of zombies in rounds called "Waves". Every set number of waves cleared, your entire gang will earn a reward for surviving onto the next wave. The event is located within Holiday Island. Purchase a Crypt furniture and place it down in your house with all gang members present. Grabbing it will start the event. Rewards this year are as follows:
[h3]Wave Rewards[/h3]
[b]Wave 51[/b]: Royal Bone Metal Storm Skin
[b]Wave 81[/b]: Cryptic M4 Skin
[b]Wave 111[/b]: PBP AR Magma Skin
[b]Wave 141[/b]: Vampiric BAR Skin
[b]Wave 171[/b]: Pumpkin Ghost Mount (Can ride over water and can be traded!)
[b]Wave 201[/b]: Dual Foices Melee (Comes with a gas mask and can be traded!)
[h3]Availability[/h3]
Crypt will open from now until November 14th at 11:00 AM EST. The unranked testing period will run from today until October 28th! From October 28th to November 14th, official scores will start being tracked for gangs looking to compete for this year's gang rewards.
[h3]Gang Rewards[/h3]
[b]1st Place[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom gas mask and choice of gun skin or custom melee
[*]15 EC per member
[*]30000 Gralats per member
[*]1st place Crypt profile animation
[/list]
[b]2nd Place[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom gas mask
[*]10 EC per member
[*]20000 Gralats per member
[*]2nd place Crypt profile animation
[/list]
[b]3rd Place[/b]
[list]
[*]Custom hat
[*]5 EC per member
[*]10000 Gralats per member
[*]3rd place Crypt profile animation
[/list]
RPG and OG scores are separate! Three gangs per game mode will place this year. Best of luck to all gangs!

notes.title: Trick or Treat Event 2024
notes.notes:
It's that time of the year again! Trick or treating is live on Era again. There are 8 major door areas to trick or treat at scattered across the map. Grind knocks with your friends to earn hats and candy. This year there will be:

[list]
[*]10 unique hats to earn by knocking
[*]6 new candy foods to obtain with each knock
[*]A special Grave Digger melee reward for hitting 7000 knocks
[/list]

You can find new baskets at the Holiday Shop Island to use for trick or treating this year. Your total knocks are counted via a leader board available through your in-game phone menu. Use it to check your progress and bare in mind that every 50 knocks, the game will ask you to move over to the next row of doors.

notes.title: Gang Audit Logs and More
notes.notes:
Era gangs have a received two major updates: Audit logging and a new co-leader rank! This release sets the stage for additional gang-focused updates that will be coming to the game in the future.

[h3]Audit Logs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Gang leaders are now able to purchase audit logs for their gang within the gang's settings menu. The cost to enable is a one-time fee of 10000 G$.
[*]The system will track all of the different decisions made by you or your members in the past couple days or months from kicking to recruiting and more.
[*]Gang leaders are now able to toggle a "View Audit Logs" permission for individual members.
[/list]
[h3]Co-Leader Rank[/h3]
[list]
[*]A new co-leader role has been introduced to gangs. The co-leader will be able to do everything the leader can with the exception of disbanding or renaming or transferring gang ownership. This means the co-leader is able to set permissions and rank for the rest of the gang roster and manage the tag.
[*]You will see the option to promote a member to co-leader while viewing their rank and permissions.
[*]Gangs are limited to only one co-leader role at a time. Assigning another co-leader will demote the previous co-leader and remove their permissions.
[/list]
[h3]Planned Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*]Specific member tracking will come to gangs soon. This will provide gang leaders with metrics into the total time a member has spent in a base or on tag.
[*]New gang rewards are also in planning. You can leave suggestions for reward updates within the official community Discord server here: [url=discord.gg/Graalians]Official Discord[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Gun Rentals Update
notes.notes: Players are now able to rent Gralat weapons from a variety of different gun shops across Era before deciding to permanently purchase one! You'll be able to choose between a three-day rental and a seven-day rental when choosing a weapon to rent. Depending on the length of the rent you can expect to pay only three or five percent of the weapon's total cost per rental. This will allow you to try out and get a feel for any gun for only a small fraction of the cost before deciding to commit towards obtaining it. [b]You can only rent three different items at a time and will have to wait for a rental to end before being able to rent an additional item.[/b]

notes.title: September 2024 Game Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h3]Gun Rentals[/h3]
[list]
[*]Players now have the option to "Rent" a large variety of weapons from shops across the map. Use this to try items before deciding to purchase them permanently.
[*]Shop items can be rented out for three or seven days at only a tiny fraction of their "Buy" price.
[*]Players are limited to a maximum of three rentals at a time. After an item's rent period is over it will be removed from your inventory.
[/list]
[h3]Gang Audit Logs[/h3]
[list]
[*]An audit log system has been added to the game for gangs. It'll log and sort through several different member actions from recruits to kicks.
[*]To enable audit logging gang leaders will have to make a one time purchase of 10000 G$ from their gang's settings menu.
[*]"View Audit Logs" has been added as an individual member permission.
[/list]
[h3]Favorite Hats[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now favorite hats by double tapping or clicking the hat within your hat pages. Double tap or click again to remove them from your favorites.
[*]You can view your favorite hats within a separate menu accessed within your hat pages. The current limit for hat favorites is 18 hats.
[/list]
[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[h3]Auction Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*]The in-game auction house has been relocated and visually reworked. Hosted items will also now display their animations and abilities at the center of each host room.
[*]Era's auction system has been reworked to combat macro usage and keep bids fair by introducing a bid timer and cool-down.
[*]When inside the Auction House during a host players will now receive PMs about each item hosted along with their room location and item statistics.
[/list]
[h3]Trash Picking[/h3]
[list]
[*]Trash picks have been re-coded to account for inconsistencies in their pick-up range. All trash picks should now have the same "Range".
[*]This means all trash picks regardless of sprite will feel more consistent and be easier to pick trash with.
[/list]
[h3]PM Clearing[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now type "[b]/clearpms[/b]" or "[b]/cleargangpms[/b]" in overhead chat to clear your PMs or gang PMs respectively.
[/list]
[h3]Trade Tables[/h3]
[list]
[*]There is now a 2 second cool-down before you can add or remove items to a table.
[/list]
[h3]Digging[/h3]
[list]
[*]Several sections of the map have been re-enabled for digging and will also use the new digging system.
[/list]
[h1]Steam Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Reverse Keys and Gas[/h3]
[list]
[*]Key reversal and confusion gas type effects will now function when used on PC players.
[/list]
[h1]General Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Food[/h3]
[list]
[*]Food will no longer freeze you in place while the animation plays and fail to heal you. Eating food to heal should now be much more consistent.
[/list]
[h3]Multitasking and Combat[/h3]
[list]
[*]The multitasking option on iOS devices will now deactivate while within a base to prevent combat logging.
[*]The time to warp out of a base on-pause has also been increased to five seconds.
[/list]
[h3]Speed Boost Ability[/h3]
[list]
[*]The speed boost abilities of several melees should no longer persist for too long while changing levels or swapping items. 
[/list]
[h3]Specific Item Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Damage for Flux Energy Sword's main mode has been fixed.
[*]The Pirate Cutlass' cannonball ability should no longer hit you multiple times.
[*]Vanquisher's train attack should now deal consistent damage. Note that this ability is ping-dependent.
[/list]

notes.title: August 2024 Game Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[h3]Worker's License[/h3]
[list]
[*]Going forwards jobs like digging or Speedy's Pizza will require a work license to do. This means you'll need to grind other jobs like car missions or trash picking to unlock major jobs like digging or pizzas.
[*]Some trade restrictions have been instated for brand new or low-stat accounts.
[*]You'll receive a checklist for job progress towards your new license when trying to perform locked jobs. License requirements and new account restrictions may change over time.
[/list]
[h3]Daily Quests System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weekly and monthly grinds have been added to the Daily Quests section found in the "Feedback" phone menu! You'll earn far more currency upon the completion of a weekly or monthly quest.
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life[/h1]
[h3]Multitask System[/h3]
[list]
[*]The automatic warp-on-pause system in bases has been tweaked. You'll no longer warp out instantly and now have three seconds to return to the game before you're warped.
[*]This change tackles combat logging and being warped out for receiving notifications. The change may come to other game modes eventually and the duration for being warped is subject to change.
[/list]
[h3]Digging Job Rework[/h3]
[list]
[*]Digging as a job has been completely overhauled. You'll now have to stay on the move and dig at random in the sand to spawn sink holes nearby. Dig out these sink holes in time to yield shells like before.
[*]The amount of shells you'll earn has been permanently buffed to compensate for increased effort.
[/list]

[h1]Steam Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Controller Input[/h3]
[list]
[*]A fire rate bug tied to controller inputs on Steam has been patched. Guns with burst modes or explosive projectiles can no longer be rapidly spammed past their intended fire rates.
[*]An issue which caused you to freeze in place while swinging melees or using certain items with a controller has also been fixed.
[/list]

[h1]General Bug Fixes[/h1]
[h3]Level Desync and Base Flags[/h3]
[list]
[*]We've implemented code that can detect for players who've been affected by the level desync bug in order to warp them out of the level. False positives may sometimes occur.
[*]This patch helps prevent player immortality within bases which could be abused with items like the Dart Gun.
[*]Additionally players affected by the level desync bug who've not been caught by the checks will no longer be able to deal damage to flags or other players while outside of a flag room or base.
[/list]
[h3]Box Factory[/h3]
[list]
[*]An ancient bug which caused players to spawn directly outside the base's door on death and not the heal room has been patched. Players will now spawn in Box Factory's heal room on death.
[/list]
[h3]Dimension Rifle[/h3]
[list]
[*]A bug which allowed the Dimension Rifle's portals shot in a previous level to carry over to a new level on entry has been patched. Users will no longer be able to abuse this to reach a base's flag easier.
[/list]
[h3]House Templates[/h3]
[list]
[*]The Summer 2024 and Plasma Corp house templates are both functional and able to be purchased now.
[*]You may have to swap out your house template and reapply it to see the fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Digging Rework and Double Job XP
notes.notes:
Seriously? Digging has been revamped on Era? Yup! The job's been given some fresh mechanics and graphics to make it a lot more fresh and engaging. The amount of shells you can earn per shovel has also been slightly increased. Going forwards as you dig into the sand sinkholes will appear at random all around you: Run up to one of these sinkholes and dig them up with your shovels to yield some shells. We hope you dig the rework!

Double job XP will also be enabled from August 23rd to August 25th! Grab a friend and come earn double the earnings for all jobs on Era this weekend!

notes.title: Summer Shop 2024
notes.notes:
Summer has arrived on Era! Dress for the heat and head on down to Era's Water Park for all new summertime goods! We've stocked up the Summer Shop with an array of all-new hats, items, furniture and house templates fit for the season. Just remember to cool down and don't miss out on some refreshing new treats sold at the stands outside the shop!

Additional content this year includes a mini grind event for you and your friends: Dig up and kill 150 crabs total and head towards the locked door in the Summer Shop building to unlock something cool!

notes.title: Era Hotel Rework and Quest
notes.notes: Era Hotel has been restored to former glory following the mafia's takeover and Era Police need your help! Era's police force has requested that you help investigate a murder that took place during the hotel's renovations. Will you help solve this violent crime? Head down to Era Hotel and partake in a new quest to earn some free new rewards!

notes.title: Pirate Zone Event
notes.notes: Event has been rescheduled to the 20th of July onward due to a couple fixes we still need to implement! Check out the new announcement!

notes.title: Era Media Building
notes.notes:
Hey Era! Season 1 of the media shop has finally released! You can find the building at the very top center of the map where the old Facebook building used to be! For this update we've introduced an all-new currency type: Social Coins! You can earn Social Coins through keeping up with GraalOnline's official media platforms and partaking in events and giveaways. You can then redeem your hard earned coins for awesome new loot from gun skins to new melees and plenty of awesome hats! Here are just a few ways you can currently earn some Social Coins:

- Participate and win on-stream events with us over at twitch.tv/GraalOnline

- Purchase coins with on-platform Gralats earned through our official Twitch and Discord

- Participate in giveaways within our official Discord (Use server invite "Graalians"!)

Happy earning and thanks for playing GraalOnline Era!

notes.title: Cinco de Mayo Shop 2024
notes.notes: Bienvenidos! Come down and celebrate with us at the Cinco de Mayo restaurant! Bring your friends along and check out what we have in store this year from special new hats, tasty dishes, awesome melees, to festive toys! I heard an old friend from Ornament Town has also paid us a visit this year with their own goodies for sale! Search for the "Cinco de Mayo" shop on your map to locate it and don't miss out!

notes.title: Easter Shop and Hunt 2024
notes.notes: Hello everyone! Era's annual egg hunt has arrived! Eggs and plastic eggs have started spawning around the map! Egg count has been reset and plastic eggs from previous years are disabled (You won't get loot by opening them). Plastic eggs come stuffed full of hats and eggs. The small eggs you collect can be spent over at the Holiday Shop on various goodies as you go about your hunt. If you're new and want to collect eggs, purchase the Easter Basket right outside the Holiday Shop and equip it to start picking up any egg. Happy hunting!

notes.title: Earth Day 2024 Event
notes.notes: It’s that time of the year again… Earth Day! Show your appreciation for the planet by keeping the streets of Era City clean and litter-free! Grab your trash pick and help clean up the city to be rewarded with 10 lovely new hats to celebrate Earth Day 2024! Pick up 200 trash in total to collect all the hats. Type "earthdaytrashcount" in overhead chat to check your progress. Happy recycling!

notes.title: St Patrick's Day Event
notes.notes: Saint Patrick’s Day is here and a legion of evil leprechauns have been unleashed upon Era City! Hunt them down for awesome loot, then run over to the Holiday Building because it just restocked with some Saint Patrick’s Day wares! Feeling lucky?

notes.title: Valentine's Holiday Shop
notes.notes: It's the season of love, and a swarm of giant Cupid monsters has begun to overtake Era City! Defeat their hordes and stock up on their valuable dropped hearts to spend at the Holiday Shop! The new Valentine’s Shop features several new furniture, hats, and items! The event and shop will last until April. Good luck!
